4094-5742-5743-8242.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
4094-5742-5743-8242.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Songbird by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Songbird ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-6772--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6772--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7893-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-7893-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

851-2557-4365-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

275-3836-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Urza.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1090-3375-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2762-5334-6792.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Mm'menon triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4496-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

586-2438-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3808-4659-5394.description:
Activate Halsin by paying {1}, causing an artifact token you control to become a 4/4 Bear in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Bear, adding {C}{C}.
When the Bear dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat.
3808-4659-5394.notes: With the excess mana, you can instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities.

546-1409-4613-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 5 or more life this turn.
546-1409-4613-7230.description:
Activate Cryptborn Horror by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Cryptborn Horror enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Cryptborn Horror enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Cryptborn Horror.
Activate Cryptborn Horror using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-679-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
392-679-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

1061-4603-7175.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-7175.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-7175.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

2034-5086-5183-6705-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6705-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

2871-7117.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, giving a creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.

1781-6871-7033.description:
Cause Bumi to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat step 2 each combat phase.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-4428-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-4428-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

1170-1329-1414-4785.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3259-5734-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-6797-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5434-5555-6797-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-6797-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

64-1462-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
64-1462-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1462-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

643-1789-5649-6797.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-5231-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2232-2499-6470.notablePrerequisites: You control and own a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana.
2232-2499-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve the Iridescent Tiger triggers, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Cast the creature returned to your hand by paying its mana cost. 
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand with the first trigger and returning nothing with the second trigger.
Repeat.

2533-2719-4681-5231.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

1074-4222-4549.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to King Macar.
1074-4222-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping King Macar, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling a creature an opponent controls and creating a Gold artifact token.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

64-654-1541-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Warden of the Eye, adding {C}{C}.
When Warden of the Eye dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Warden of the Eye on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Warden of the Eye from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Warden of the Eye and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Warden of the Eye triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1219-1409-2348-4438-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Beledros.
"Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.
1219-1409-2348-4438-4875.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Beledros by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Beledros enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

282-1494-2646.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
 Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
282-1494-2646.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-3995-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to Horseshoe Crab.
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
539-3995-4878.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {G}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {U} and one mana of any color.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat

2-1651-1770-4563.notablePrerequisites:
Everflowing Chalice has at least four charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four.
2-1651-1770-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

389-1149-2770.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Nine Lives to leave the battlefield.
389-1149-2770.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving an opponent control of Nine Lives.
If needed, activate Shadowspear by paying {1}, causing all permanents your opponents control to lose hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
Cause Nine Lives to leave the battlefield.
Nine Lives triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

1597-2645.notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1597-2645.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Gyre Sage.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1597-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

570-4896.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control a black and a red permanent.
570-4896.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

1636-3064-4050.notablePrerequisites: Pride Sovereign does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3064-4050.description:
Activate Pride Sovereign by paying {W}, tapping and exerting Pride Sovereign, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
The Cat tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm twice, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

950-1261.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
950-1261.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1003-4050-4314-5105.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {W}.
Pawn of Ulamog and Sigil of the New Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.
